title: Careers at

hero.text: Join a team shaping recovery, restoring lives and redefining care across the region.

intro.ariaLabel: Be part of a purpose that transforms lives

image.alt: Two Cambridge Hospital clinicians standing back to back

heading: Be Part of a
Purpose That
Transforms Lives
text: At Cambridge Hospital, our people come together around a shared purpose: to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients and their families.

We are committed to clinical excellence and meaningful human impact, helping patients recover, regain function, maintain dignity and achieve a better quality of life. Being part of Cambridge Hospital means contributing to a healthcare system where the work you do has a tangible and lasting impact on the people and communities we serve.

Across the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, our growing network provides opportunities to be part of a healthcare organisation that is helping shape the future of rehabilitation, long-term care and recovery across the region.

life.heading: Life at Cambridge Hospital
sub: Our people are at the heart of everything we do.
text: At Cambridge Hospital, we value the expertise our people bring and create opportunities for them to develop, contribute and progress.

Working alongside experienced clinicians, healthcare specialists and professionals across disciplines, you will have the opportunity to gain exposure to different perspectives, learn from others, develop your expertise and grow in your career.

As part of a growing team, you will be encouraged to bring your knowledge and ideas to the workplace, take on new challenges and build meaningful professional relationships, while being part of a workplace where people support one another and take pride in the impact they make.

blocks.text: Our teams bring together a diverse range of clinical, specialist and professional expertise, including:
Each function contributes to a unified model of care designed to support patients and their families at every stage of recovery.
Cambridge Hospital is designed not only to deliver care, but to develop the people who make that care possible.

items: Exposure to multidisciplinary practice and collaboration
Participation in evolving care models across the region

blocks.text: For clinicians and healthcare specialists, this means opportunities to deepen their expertise in specialised rehabilitation and long-term care.
For non-clinical professionals, it means developing their expertise while contributing to a healthcare system with tangible regional impact and increasing operational sophistication.
Development at Cambridge Hospital is about more than career progression. It is about growing through meaningful contribution, greater responsibility and increasing professional exposure.
Purpose is central to the Cambridge Hospital employer identity.
People do not join this organisation simply to fill a role. They join to contribute to recovery, dignity, function and the long-term well-being of patients and their families.
That purpose is reflected across every area of the organisation, whether a team member is:

items: Ensuring safety and continuity behind the scenes

blocks.text: This gives the workplace a different kind of value. The work is not abstract; its impact is visible, personal and deeply meaningful.
Cambridge Hospital operates across multiple facilities in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Being part of this regional network means contributing to:

items: An integrated and standardised care model
A network with multi-site capability and long-term expansion potential

blocks.text: It also means that work at Cambridge Hospital is connected to broader healthcare transformation across the region, particularly in areas of rehabilitation, long-term care and recovery support.

talent.heading: National Talent Development
talent.text: At Cambridge Hospital, we are committed to developing national talent and building sustainable healthcare capabilities in both the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

photo.alt: An Emirati woman and man, Cambridge Hospital clinicians

blocks.heading: United Arab Emirates
paragraphs: In the United Arab Emirates, Cambridge Hospital actively supports Emiratisation through structured pathways that help Emirati professionals enter, develop and progress within the healthcare sector.

This commitment reflects more than compliance with workforce priorities. It reflects the organisation’s belief that strong healthcare systems must also contribute to national capability-building by developing talent across the full spectrum of healthcare professions and specialities.

By supporting Emirati talent across medical, nursing, allied health, rehabilitation, clinical specialist, healthcare delivery and operational roles, Cambridge Hospital contributes to long-term system resilience while creating meaningful opportunities for Emirati professionals to build their expertise and advance their careers.

The organisation’s engagement with institutions such as Fatima College of Health Sciences reflects this broader commitment to nurturing future healthcare talent and creating pathways for Emirati professionals.

blocks.heading: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
paragraphs: In the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Cambridge Hospital actively supports Saudisation by developing local talent across its facilities and functions, strengthening national participation across the full spectrum of clinical, specialist, healthcare and non-clinical roles.

This commitment is especially important in a regional context where healthcare growth must be matched by sustainable local workforce development and the continued development of Saudi healthcare professionals across a broad range of specialities.

Through structured opportunities, multidisciplinary exposure and participation in specialised care environments, Cambridge Hospital contributes to healthcare capability-building in line with Saudi Arabia’s priorities and long-term sector development.

cta.heading: Start Your Career Journey with Us!
cta.text: Explore open roles across our network and become part of a team dedicated to delivering exceptional care and meaningful impact.
